versions.changelog:
Multi-Web-Search v3.4.0 – Major update with expanded search modalities and network enhancements.

- Added support for image, news, video, and book searches (--type parameter).
- Introduced DHT network acceleration for up to 90% faster repeated queries.
- Integrated proxy support for private and region-unlocked searches.
- New configurable per-engine timeout (--timeout).
- Improved zero-config fallback (DuckDuckGo Lite) and enhanced multi-language/documentation search support.
